meta.title: Oleksandr Vdovychenko, Web & Bot Developer
meta.description: Web and bot developer based in Poznan. I build websites and Telegram bots for small businesses.

hero.tagline: I build websites and bots for small businesses.
hero.subline: Next.js, TypeScript, Python. Websites and bots, end to end.

about.label: 01 / about
about.p1: I've been building websites and bots for a few years now. Some I make for clients, some for myself. The latest one I'm proudest of is <link>English Nerd</link>, a free English learning platform I built from scratch as both the developer and the teacher behind the lessons. It has over 100 lessons, level tests, and a paid Pro tier.
about.p2: Before code, I taught English. I still do. That keeps showing up in how I work: I care about the small stuff, I explain things in plain language, and I notice when something on a page makes you stop and squint.
about.p3: I speak five languages, I've lived in seven countries, and I'm currently in Poznan. Most of my clients find me through word of mouth, which I think says something useful about how I work.
about.p4: Outside the freelance work, I run a Telegram channel about English at <telegram>@EnglishNerd</telegram> and sell teaching materials on <tpt>Teachers Pay Teachers</tpt>. The two sides of what I do feed each other.

projects.label: 02 / projects
projects.subheader: A few things I've built and shipped.

services.label: 03 / services
services.card1Desc: Marketing sites, learning platforms, booking sites — anything that needs to look right and load fast.
services.card2Desc: Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord. Mostly automation: scraping, summarizing, formatting, posting, answering. If it's a repetitive thing your team does in chat, a bot can probably do it.
services.card3Desc: Pipelines that take input from somewhere (URL, form, file), run it through an LLM, and put the result somewhere useful (chat, doc, email).
services.pricing: Pricing depends on scope and complexity. Write to me with the details and I'll give you a concrete number.

process.label: 04 / process
process.step1Body: Write to me on Telegram or email. No brief needed — just tell me what you're trying to build. We'll work out the rest together.
process.step2Body: Within a day, usually. What I'll build, how long, how much. If something in your idea won't work, I tell you that too.
process.step3Body: Small projects (a landing page, a simple bot) take a few days. Bigger things take a few weeks. You see progress along the way, not at the end.
process.step4Body: Code on GitHub, deployed and running, with a short doc on how to maintain or extend it. If you want me to keep maintaining it after that, that's a separate conversation.

contact.label: 05 / contact
contact.heading: Have an idea? Tell me about it.
contact.p1: The form below sends straight to my Telegram, so I see it within minutes. If you'd rather just write directly, the buttons below the form work too.
contact.p2: I'm in Poznan time, so if you're in the US, my mornings are your nights.
